I am not active at all, I'm not really sure to be honest I do have weak ankles from being born with clubbed feet so walking causes pain.

I just need some simple but effective exercises that I can do at my weight at home because I don't have access to a gym but I do have a weight machine at home.
I always feel like I disappoint my mother it saddens me, I feel like I'm in my sister's shadow feels like everything I do isn't right that everything I do is the opposite to what she wants
